articles.summary: BOULDER, Colorado—May 2, 2018 — OnKure, Inc., the epigenetics–focused drug discovery and development company that is advancing the first Largazole-derived, histone deacetylase inhibitor into Phase 1 clinical trials, announced that it has completed a $7M Series A financing. Delian Capital led the investment round with participation from existing and new investors including OnKure management. TheRead More
articles.title: OnKure Close $7M Series A Financing to Support Development of Epigenetics Drug
